name: OrcaSlicer MCP
description: Work a running OrcaSlicer with AI: load models, arrange the plate, tune settings, slice, and understand the result through slice breakdowns, setting explanations, and physics checks. Talks to OrcaSlicer on localhost or a host you configure and, for the printer tools, makes read-only requests to your printer; no cloud calls from this server.
author: maxellis

deploymentOptions.description: Run straight from PyPI with uv; no install step.

ORCA_API_TOKEN.description: Remote API token from the OrcaSlicer MCP build (Preferences -> Remote API)

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Snapshot of the current OrcaSlicer session: app and project info, the active print/filament/printer presets with which of their keys are modified (dirty), whether the last slice is still valid, and whether a slice is running. Read-only.

tools.name: get_config
tools.description: Read merged config values (optionally filtered to `keys`).

tools.name: set_config
tools.description: Apply config changes to the active project as unsaved overrides, atomically: if any key is invalid the whole batch is rejected and nothing changes. Returns {applied, errors}.

tools.name: slice
tools.description: Start slicing the current plate in the background and return immediately, without waiting for the result. The reply is 'started' (a slice began), 'already_valid' (the plate is unchanged and the last result still holds), or a conflict if a slice is already running.

tools.name: get_slice_status
tools.description: State of the current or most recent slice: state (slicing, done, error, or idle), stats (print time and filament use when done), and any warnings or errors. Read-only.

tools.name: get_slice_warnings
tools.description: Just the warnings/errors from the last (or current) slice, plus validity: the fast 'did anything go wrong' check and the way to confirm a fix cleared.

tools.name: get_slice_breakdown
tools.description: Per-feature breakdown of the last slice + a stateless predicted-vs-observed flow check.

tools.name: cancel_slice
tools.description: Abort a running slice, or unwedge a stale 'slicing' state (e.g. after an object outside the bed). Safe when idle.

tools.name: slice_and_wait
tools.description: Slice the current plate and block until it finishes, then return the final stats and warnings in one call. If the plate is already sliced and unchanged, it returns the existing result without re-slicing.

tools.name: apply_and_slice
tools.description: Apply config overrides and then slice in one step, returning {applied, errors, result} with the resulting stats and warnings. The changes are atomic (any invalid key rejects the whole batch) and unsaved, exactly like set_config, so they revert if the preset is reselected.

tools.name: compare_settings
tools.description: For each value of `key`, slice and collect stats/warnings; restore the original when done.

tools.name: compare_slices
tools.description: Slice the current plate under several named variants and compare the cost of each.

tools.name: list_objects
tools.description: List objects on the current plate: id (stable), name, size_mm, and transform (offset/rotation/scale).

tools.name: set_object_config
tools.description: Set per-object config overrides on an object by id, e.g. {"wall_loops": 4, "sparse_infill_density": "30%"}. Atomic (nothing applied if any key is invalid).

tools.name: duplicate_object
tools.description: Duplicate an object on the plate by id (adds a copy, offset from the original).

tools.name: delete_object
tools.description: Remove one object from the current plate by id. This is permanent within the session and cannot be undone through the API; the other objects keep their ids.

tools.name: transform_object
tools.description: Move/rotate/scale an object by id. translate=[dx,dy,dz] mm (relative), rotate=[rx,ry,rz] degrees (relative), scale=[sx,sy,sz] absolute factor. Provide at least one.

tools.name: arrange_plate
tools.description: Auto-arrange all objects on the plate (async job; poll get_job_status until idle).

tools.name: auto_orient
tools.description: Auto-orient all objects for printing (async job; poll get_job_status until idle).

tools.name: get_job_status
tools.description: Whether the plate's background job worker is idle or still running. Read-only.

tools.name: watch_events
tools.description: Collect live events (slice.*/config.changed/project.opened) over a bounded window.

tools.name: find_config_keys
tools.description: Find config keys containing `substring` (helps discover among the ~600 keys).

tools.name: diagnose_plate
tools.description: One-call plate diagnosis: app/slice status, objects on the plate, bed + active skirt/brim/clearance settings, and the last slice's warnings, so you don't have to chain status->objects->config. Start here for 'why won't this slice / fit'.

tools.name: check_placement
tools.description: Estimate whether every object (plus its skirt/brim ring) fits inside the printable area. Returns per-object fit, expanded first-layer bbox, per-edge clearance (mm), and overflow.

tools.name: consult
tools.description: Retrieve curated slicing knowledge + saved context notes for a topic, symptom, or intent. ALWAYS call before deriving or changing settings for a user goal. Composes principles per situation, never returns preset bundles. Falls back to find_config_keys/web search if empty.

tools.name: check_profile_physics
tools.description: Deterministic pre-save gate: fetches the live config, overlays optional proposed `changes`, and runs flow/temperature/geometry/cooling math. RUN THIS BEFORE save_preset. verdict=blocked means DO NOT SAVE.

tools.name: remember
tools.description: Persist a context fact for future sessions. scope: 'machine:<printer>/<filament>', 'user', or 'project:<name>'. Local plain files; user-readable and deletable.

tools.name: describe_setting
tools.description: Authoritative definition of one OrcaSlicer setting: label, tooltip, type, unit, valid range, enum values, and default. Read-only and offline, so it works even when OrcaSlicer is not running.

tools.name: search_settings
tools.description: Search settings by keyword across key/label/tooltip; returns compact matches (key, label, category, short tooltip), ranked key/label first. Offline.

tools.name: load_model
tools.description: Load a model file (path on the OrcaSlicer host) onto the current plate. Accepts .stl/.obj/.3mf, plus .step/.stp on fork v2.3.2-mcp.3+. Large STEP files can take a minute to tessellate; the call waits.

tools.name: select_preset
tools.description: Make the named preset the active one for its group (print, filament, or printer).

tools.name: save_preset
tools.description: Save the currently edited settings as a named user preset (create or update, visible in the GUI immediately). type = print|filament|printer. detach=True saves it standalone instead of inheriting the current base preset; use it when creating a filament preset for a DIFFERENT material than the one selected, otherwise the new preset inherits the base's filament_type and temperatures.

tools.name: list_presets
tools.description: List print/filament/printer presets with system/selected/visible flags.

tools.name: set_layer_height
tools.description: Variable layer height for one object. mode='adaptive' (quality 0..1, higher = finer detail) generates an adaptive profile; mode='reset' (aliases: 'default', 'none') restores uniform layers.

tools.name: set_height_range
tools.description: Override the layer height over a Z band of one object (e.g. 0 to 5 mm printed at 0.1 mm for finer detail near the base). Passing the same min_z and max_z again updates that band's height; clear=True removes every band on the object.

tools.name: get_preset_config
tools.description: Read the full settings of a named preset without selecting it. type = print|filament|printer.

tools.name: delete_preset
tools.description: Delete a USER preset (system presets and the currently-selected one are refused). type = print|filament|printer.

tools.name: edit_preset
tools.description: Edit a named preset's settings and persist them: selects it, applies the changes atomically, saves under the same name.

tools.name: rename_preset
tools.description: Rename a user preset by copying it to new_name, selecting the copy, and deleting the original. Only user presets can be renamed; system presets are read-only.

tools.name: get_gcode
tools.description: Retrieve the last successful slice's G-code as text.

tools.name: describe_plate
tools.description: Machine-readable plate facts from the last slice's G-code, per object, so you can answer orientation and placement questions instead of guessing from Euler angles or a picture: how the part stands (flat / tilted / on an edge or corner, from first-layer contact versus its widest layer), the first-layer footprint as islands, where overhang extrusions concentrate by 10 mm height band, where support stands and where its interface touches the part, and which side the outer-wall seams sit on (checked against seam_position).

tools.name: save_gcode
tools.description: Save the last successful slice's G-code and record the slice (model, a fingerprint of the objects' names and sizes, full settings snapshot, and OrcaSlicer's time and filament estimates) in the local outcome store under that filename.

tools.name: recall_prints
tools.description: How did past prints of THIS model actually turn out? Matches the current plate by geometry (or by model_name if given / the slicer is offline), returning each past print's result (success/cancelled/error), your recorded verdict (e.g. 'warped'), and the settings it was sliced with.

tools.name: render_plate
tools.description: Render a PNG picture of the current plate so you can SEE it.

tools.name: get_printer_status
tools.description: What the 3D printer is doing right now: state (idle, heating, printing, paused, finished, cancelled, error, shutdown, offline), nozzle and bed temperatures with their targets, the current job (file, progress, layer, time elapsed and left, and what the time left is based on), and any problems the printer reports, each in the printer's own words with a plain-English hint for common ones.

tools.name: wait_for_printer
tools.description: Wait until the printer reaches a point in a print, checking every 5 seconds. Returns as soon as it happens (met: true), or at the timeout with the latest status (met: false).

tools.name: list_print_history
tools.description: How did recent prints on the printer actually end? For each finished job: result (success, cancelled or error), how long it took against the slicer's estimate, filament used, and for failed or stopped jobs the printer's own reason while its console still holds it.

tools.name: check_printer_match
tools.description: Does the active OrcaSlicer profile match the printer it will print on? Compares nozzle size, bed size and height, the highest speeds and accelerations, nozzle and bed temperatures, and firmware retraction against the printer's own Klipper settings.

prompts.name: slice-a-model
prompts.description: Guided load -> check -> slice -> read-back workflow for one model file.

prompts.name: optimize-print-time
prompts.description: Data-driven print-time reduction from a real slice breakdown, never adjectives alone.

prompts.name: edit-preset-safely
prompts.description: Preset change with the physics gate: consult -> set_config -> check_profile_physics -> save_preset.

overview.summary: MCP server that lets Claude or any MCP client operate a real, running OrcaSlicer: load models, arrange plates, tune ~800 settings with a physics sanity gate, slice, and read per-feature results back. Requires the OrcaSlicer MCP build (fork with an embedded, token-authenticated local control API).
